slice.goal: Execute exactly one bounded capability gate for GOOGLE-CONTACTS-CONTACT-WITNESS-v1 and stop after durable readback.
slice.tested_scope: Current exposed Chat Google_Contacts connector schema plus current official Google People API MCP tool surface. No personal Contacts mutation, no O mutation, no Work/manual/protected execution, no scheduler mutation, no polling/backoff/retry and no second semantic leaf.

observations.result: The available Google_Contacts connector exposes get_profile, search_contacts and read_contact. It exposes no create_contact, update_contact, delete_contact, batchCreateContacts or generic write action.
The current official People API MCP reference exposes search_directory_people, search_contacts and get_user_profile; it does not expose contact creation or mutation tools.

slice.reason: A contact-as-witness route requires Chat-native creation or mutation of a durable contact object before exact readback. The currently exposed Chat Contacts/MCP surfaces do not provide that write primitive, so the route cannot satisfy outcome parity using exposed Chat tools. REST-level People API write methods existing outside the exposed Chat tool surface do not close this leaf because residual external/manual/protected execution is forbidden.
slice.quota_note: No quota-bearing experiment was executed. The zero-finite-quota hard gate remains unproven for this route, but acceptance already fails earlier on missing exposed Chat write capability.
slice.o_comparison: Not performed because the candidate failed a prior hard Chat-capability gate before O comparison could become acceptance-relevant.

blocker: No Chat-exposed Google Contacts write primitive exists in the current connector/MCP surface for creating the proposed durable witness.
